import sys

MOD = 998244353
INV2 = 499122177

def pow_mod(base, exp):
    return pow(base, exp, MOD)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n, m, l, r = map(int, data[:4])
    d = r - l + 1
    nm = n * m
    diff = d & 1

    ans = (pow_mod(d, nm) + pow_mod(diff, nm)) % MOD
    ans = ans * INV2 % MOD
    if nm % 2 == 1:
        ans = pow_mod(d, nm)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
